qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json (hash a424b50f... verified) and workspace.cjs (hash 96410261... verified), seed-related groups only
evidence: PATHS: instruction.md:11 names /instructions/hireops_rules.md and /instructions/integration.md; instruction.md:13 names /assets/seed_data.json. All three exist under task/environment/ and environment/Dockerfile:14-16 does 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/' and chmod -R a+rX on both. task.toml artifacts = ["/app", "/assets"]. integration.md:6-7 repeats /assets/seed_data.json. No other /assets or /instructions path is named anywhere in the brief, notes or judge prompts. SOLUTION: solution/app/src/seed_data.json is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (both SHA256 A1C65C806B54DA99A37AB2B5F455EDE0A9385A09569903FB3A7F3446F7E83740, matching raw-evidence-index), and db.js:10 resolves it via path.join(__dirname,'seed_data.json') per rules §8; db.js:14-15,67-83 consume candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, interview_limit, position, rejected_from/reject_reason and read_count exactly as the seed spells them. CONTENT VS BRIEF/NOTES: the seed's 10 users, names, emails and roles match instruction.md:17 and app_context.md exactly (3 recruiters, 3 hiring managers, 1 observer, 3 candidates); stages and candidate wording match hireops_rules.md §3 and §7 table; thread_page_size 30 matches rules §6 'Long conversations'; rules §9 claims (three jobs with ordered cards, one long conversation, a few notes, read markers counted from the first message, wording and page size in the same file) all hold. Interview limits (3/2/3) are whole numbers 1-50 and no seeded job exceeds its limit (2/3, 1/2, 1/3). Positions are unique per job+stage; all message senders, note authors and read users resolve; message timestamps are strictly increasing within each conversation, so 'counted from its first' is unambiguous. CONTENT VS JUDGES (recomputed from the seed): functional Z/hro_unread_counts 'Lena Fischer starts with 1 unread' - APP-301 has 3 messages, Lena (USR-CAN3) read_count 2, message 3 is by USR-REC3, so 1 unread: correct. hro_restart/Z seeded Platform Engineer order 'Applied: Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi; Screen: Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz' matches APP-105/106/108 and APP-103/104 positions; Noor Haddad's card (APP-101, JOB-PLAT, INTERVIEW) carries note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' exactly. app_context.md '120 messages at the start' - APP-101 has exactly 120 messages (#001-#120), so hro_thread_latest/earlier pages of 30 work (90/60/30/0 remaining). Seeded Data Analyst conversation (APP-201) is Tomas's and Bill Okafor is JOB-DATA's manager, consistent with T fallback. Noor has two applications (APP-101 Interviewing, APP-302 Application received) for hro_candidate_view and visual's candidate view. Seeded state is protected for the functional run: render gate opens no conversation, constraints gate sends nothing, polish says 'Never use Lena Fischer's conversation', visual is read-only, and no criterion depends on Noor's long thread staying at exactly 120 (polish adds messages there). RUN EVIDENCE: the hash-verified scripted golden (workspace.cjs lines 49-55, 377-387, 449-452; workspace.json groups 'seeded card order and internal notes are loaded', 'unread counts...', 'restart...' all passed, page_errors []) observed the seeded Applied/Screen order, the Noor note, the #120 newest message with #061-#120 as the latest 60 after one page load, and Lena's Product Designer badge '1' - this is scripted golden evidence, not a configured judge run, Oracle or model score. ADVERSARIAL: (a) broken app that could pass - an app that ignores /assets and hard-codes a small dataset would fail Z/hro_restart order+note, hro_thread_latest/earlier (120 messages) and the Lena-1 unread check, so the criteria do depend on the shipped content; an app that reads /assets at runtime fails because instruction.md:15 says /assets is unavailable at runtime and the verifier runs separately. (b) conforming app that could fail - one that computes unread from read_count by array order or by created_at gets the same answer (strictly increasing timestamps); one that keeps seed stage keys uppercase is still judged on visible order/names, not label casing. No mismatch found between shipped inputs and what the prompt, solution and judges assume. Not exercised here: a Docker build of the agent image (mechanical half belongs to check-fixtures.py / check-assets-referenced.py in the deterministic review); the Dockerfile COPY lines and directory contents are unambiguous.
